purpose._: Locked expanded Home 2026-09-06 (Zillow-shaped after Redfin cut). Full-bleed search. Stacked house carousels. Illustrated doors. No Atlas, map block, town ledger, or market essay on home.
purpose.job: Turn someone who typed a money query into a search they can act on. Search is the Stage action. Photographed house rails and Buy/Sell/Invest doors follow.
purpose.primaryAction: Search city, community, or address. See all homes opens the Field.
purpose.audience: A buyer or looker at the top of the funnel who does not yet know the towns. NOT a seller (they arrive on /sell).
questionsItMustAnswer: What is for sale here right now?
Can I buy, sell, or invest from here?

alsoWins: homes for sale bend redmond sisters sunriver

searchIntent.whatItOwesSEO: One H1 Ryan Realty, Bend. Town and resort names as real doors. JSON-LD that matches the visible figures.
